162623756.name: PTI-3
162623756.description: PTI-3 is an indole-3-thiazole based synthetic cannabinoid which has been sold as a designer drug. It was first identified in Hungary in 2020, and was made illegal in Italy in June 2021.

163112076.name: Karmitoxin
163112076.description: Karmitoxin is an amine-containing polyhydroxy-polyene toxin isolated from Karlodinium armiger strain K-0668.

165365644.name: Polonium hexafluoride
165365644.description: Polonium hexafluoride is a possible chemical compound of polonium and fluorine and one of the seventeen known binary hexafluorides.

169450636.name: MDL-811
169450636.description: MDL-811 is a drug which acts as a sirtuin-6 activator. It has antiinflammatory effects and shows neuroprotective effects in animal models of stroke and heart attack.

170763788.name: 1T-LSD
170763788.description: 1T-LSD, also known as 1- -LSD or as SYN-L-021, is an acylated derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide , which has been sold as a designer drug.

175097868.name: Einsteinium(II) iodide
175097868.description: Einsteinium iodide is a binary inorganic chemical compound of einsteinium and iodide with the chemical formula EsI2.

900000012.name: 1Bz-LSD
900000012.description: 1Bz-LSD, also known as 1-benzoyl-LSD or as SYN-L-018, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

900000140.name: Alteplase
900000140.description: Alteplase, sold under the brand name Activase among others, is a biosynthetic form of human tissue-type plasminogen activator .

900000268.name: Bepirovirsen
900000268.description: Bepirovirsen is an antisense oligonucleotide gapmer developed to treat hepatitis B infection.

900000396.name: Californium(III) oxychloride
900000396.description: Californium oxychloride is a radioactive salt first discovered in measurable quantities in 1960. It was the first californium compound ever isolated.

900000524.name: CuSil
900000524.description: CuSil is a tradename for an alloy in the billon family of 72% silver and 28% copper marketed by Morgan Advanced Materials.

900000652.name: Drozitumab
900000652.description: Drozitumab is a human monoclonal antibody in development for the treatment of cancers.

900000780.name: Ethulose
900000780.description: Ethulose is a laxative. It is also known as ethylhydroxyethylcellulose. As a food additive with INS number 467, ethulose is used as an emulsifier.

900000908.name: Graphyne
900000908.description: Graphyne is an allotrope of carbon. Although it has been studied in theoretical models, it is very difficult to synthesize and only small amounts of uncertain purity have been created.

900001036.name: Iodine (131 I) derlotuximab biotin
900001036.description: Iodine derlotuximab biotin is a monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of recurrent glioblastoma multiforme.

900001164.name: Lithium tetrahydridogallate
900001164.description: Lithium tetrahydridogallate is the inorganic compound with formula LiGaH4. It is a white solid similar to but less thermally robust than lithium aluminium hydride.

900001292.name: Moxetumomab pasudotox
900001292.description: Moxetumomab pasudotox, sold under the brand name Lumoxiti, is an anti-CD22 immunotoxin medication for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory hairy cell leukemia who have received at...

900001420.name: Olezarsen
900001420.description: Olezarsen, sold under the brand name Tryngolza, is a medication used in the treatment of familial chylomicronemia syndrome.

900001548.name: Phosphetene
900001548.description: A phosphetene is an unsaturated four-membered organophosphorus heterocycle containing one phosphorus atom.

900001676.name: Polyvinylidene chloride
900001676.description: Polyvinylidene chloride, or polyvinylidene dichloride , is a homopolymer of vinylidene chloride.

900001804.name: Robatumumab
900001804.description: Robatumumab (proposed INN; also known as SCH 717454 and MK-7454) is a monoclonal antibody and an antineoplastic by Merck and Schering-Plough.

900002188.name: Yariv reagent
900002188.description: Yariv reagent (1,3,5-tri -2,4,6-trihydroxybenzene) is a glycosylated phenolic compound that binds strongly to galactans and arabinogalactan proteins.
